name: Sound FX
author: izicubed
description: Play custom MP3/WAV/OGG sound files on race events: staging, start, finish, stop, winner declared, every lap, holeshot, pilot finished, race saved and more. Upload a personal sound for each pilot (e.g. their name callout) and it is played when that pilot records a lap, scores the holeshot, finishes or wins — each trigger individually selectable. Sounds are uploaded from the Settings page and played in every connected browser; a standalone /sound_fx/player page lets any phone or tablet on the network act as a dedicated speaker. Optional playback on the server's own audio output (mpg123/ffplay). No extra dependencies.
